responsibility: Defines the PDP-11 backend’s machine constraints used by reload and instruction recognition to classify legal registers, immediates, and memory addressing forms in pdp11.md. It assigns constraint letters for FPU and multiply-capable register classes, constant shapes such as 16-bit unsigned values, zero, +/-1, and small shift counts, distinguishes simple opcode-encoded memory operands from operands needing an extra word, and adds special Z* constraints that detect push/pop auto-increment or auto-decrement forms tied to particular registers so the machine description can avoid PDP-11 destination/source aliasing cases with model-dependent behavior.
